Students will be exempted from various professional examinations upon graduation. Statistical Decision Sciences (code: 6779) offers three specialized Professional Cores under the accredited degree Bachelor of Statistics (BStat) . Students can choose to specialize in Decision Analytics, Risk Management or Statistics, and freely switch Professional Cores during studies. BStat graduates are qualified to become a Graduate Statistician (GradStat) designated by the Royal Statistical Society.
